items.text: Saquon Barkley and DeVonta Smith officially off injury report, good to go for MNF vs Bears. Hollywood Brown OUT.
items.implication: PHI offense full strength MNF; Barkley lead back, Smith WR1
items.opportunity: No snap/role reduction; reverse any handcuff elevation

items.text: Caleb Williams officially ruled OUT for MNF vs Eagles. Tyson Bagent full participant, Questionable.
items.implication: Bagent likely start; CHI pass catchers (Odunze/Burden/Moore) face uncertainty/downgrade
items.opportunity: Monitor Bagent; limited upside for CHI skill

items.text: Puka Nacua listed DOUBTFUL for Sunday Night Football. ETR and Levitan note not expected to play; prior uncertainty resolved toward out.
items.why: Hip/groin; did not practice fully; multiple reports not expected
items.implication: Davante Adams and Kyren Williams see expanded targets/routes; Adams primary WR1
items.opportunity: Adams routes/targets surge; WR2/3 volume to Whittington or others

items.text: Nico Collins officially OUT. Confirmed across ETR list and Schefter ruled-out compilation.
items.implication: Dalton Schultz target share jumps to ~28-30%; other HOU WRs elevated
items.opportunity: Schultz 30% routes targeted last week without Collins; TE1 upside vs IND

items.text: Jayden Daniels OUT. Not IR per reports; Mariota starts. Corroborated by Schefter/Rapoport.
items.implication: McLaurin target share holds ~25% with Mariota historically but tough SEA matchup; WAS offense capped
items.opportunity: Limited; reverse any prior Daniels-dependent stacks

items.text: Rico Dowdle OUT. ETR list and Schefter confirmation; Warren projected lead back.
items.implication: Jaylen Warren assumes lead role + checkdowns; clear RB1 volume
items.opportunity: Warren snaps/carries/routes expand significantly; goal-line work

items.text: Projecting Jaylen Warren (shoulder, Q) IN as lead back with Dowdle out; expects checkdown volume and full opportunity.
items.why: Shoulder but LP/practice progress; Dowdle absence clears path
items.implication: RB1 upside with expanded snaps, carries, routes; DFS priority
items.opportunity: Lead + checkdowns; 15+ touches history on volume

items.text: Projecting Brock Bowers (knee Q) and Mike Evans (hip Q) IN. Clarity hoped on Flowers/Moore early.
items.why: Practice indicators positive; ETR projections live
items.implication: Bowers TE1 locked; Evans WR1 volume intact for TB

items.text: Jonathon Brooks OUT and expected IR. Hubbard firmly lead back.
items.why: Injury leading to IR; limited prior games
items.implication: Chuba Hubbard lead role locked; Dillon backup

items.text: Alec Pierce OUT (heel/IR context). Downs perimeter role expands.
items.implication: Josh Downs target share to 36%; more perimeter routes
items.opportunity: Downs no longer slot-only; elevated WR2

items.text: LOVE Dalton Schultz @ IND: 28% target share last week w/ Collins out; IND 4th-most yds to TEs.
items.why: Collins absence drives 30% route targets; soft TE matchup

items.text: After Stevenson fumble, TreVeyon Henderson 65% snaps and 16-5 touch advantage rest of game. Outlook improved but not full takeover yet.
items.why: Post-fumble lead; pass pro still limits full role
items.implication: Henderson flex/upgrade candidate; Stevenson still ranked ahead weekly
items.conflict: Berry ranks Stevenson ahead but notes narrowed gap

items.text: LOVE Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush prop 88.5; DAL 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.why: Elite matchup vs poor rush D; volume prop high

items.text: LOVE Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches +15% targets both weeks; RB7 utilization; PIT allows 5th-most rush yds to RBs.
LOVE Chris Olave vs LV: double-digit targets both weeks, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards; LV allows league-high 18.7 ypr to WRs.
HATE Rhamondre Stevenson @ JAX: post-fumble 31% snaps/5 touches; JAX allows only 55 rush yds/g to RBs, 3.2 YPC.
items.why: Role loss after fumble + tough run D
items.conflict: Berry still ranks Stevenson ahead ROS/weekly but hates spot

items.text: HATE Travis Etienne vs LV: only 49% RB touches, 38% 3rd-down snaps even w/ Kamara; RB37 utilization.
items.why: Committee role not there; low snaps
items.conflict: ETR has him IN but usage poor

items.text: HATE Terry McLaurin vs SEA: SEA fewest FP to WRs, 7.9 ypr allowed; WAS lowest implied total 17; Daniels out.
items.why: Tough matchup + low team total + QB change
